articles.title: Bolt the Bomb-Sniffing Dog Wins the TSA's Cutest Canine Contest
articles.summary: A three-year-old German shorthaired pointer named Bolt just won the TSA's Cutest Canine Contest for 2026. He sniffs for explosives at Dallas Fort Worth airport. His handler says he's a hard-working character who loves his job.

articles.title: NASA's Roman Telescope: A Hubble-Sized Mirror with a 100-Times Wider View
articles.summary: NASA's Roman Space Telescope launches in two days. It has a mirror the same size as Hubble's but images 100 times more sky. It will study dark matter, dark energy, and directly image exoplanets.

articles.title: This 'Moonish Thingy' Is Blurring the Line Between Planet and Moon
articles.summary: Astronomers found a Jupiter-sized object orbiting a brown dwarf, which orbits a star. It's the first known 'exosatellite'—a new category that challenges our definition of a planet.
